units.sourceHTML: 11 Reporting bugs ¶

units.text: There are probably bugs in ⟦0⟧. There are certainly errors and omissions in this manual. If you report them, they will get fixed. If you don’t, no one will ever know about them and they will remain unfixed for all eternity, if not longer.
units.sourceHTML: There are probably bugs in ed. There are certainly errors and omissions in this manual. If you report them, they will get fixed. If you don’t, no one will ever know about them and they will remain unfixed for all eternity, if not longer.

units.text: If you find a bug in ⟦0⟧, please send electronic mail to ⟦1⟧bug-ed@gnu.org⟦2⟧. Include the version number, which you can find by running ‘⟦3⟧’⟦4⟧.
units.sourceHTML: If you find a bug in ed, please send electronic mail to bug-ed@gnu.org. Include the version number, which you can find by running ‘ed --version’.
